artifacts.summary: Four-phase, 3-hour plan landing the one-sided count-move refutation as a wired, self-contained evidence probe with non-vacuity discharged in-file, plus same-round gate wiring; 26 pinned Lean Challenge statements; no FormalSystem/ or Tests/ edits.

memory_candidates.content: Promoting a task-directory Lean prototype to a wired evidence probe under specs/evidence/ in this repository carries three structural obligations that are easy to miss at planning time. (1) Probes are compiled with `lake env lean` outside the Lake module graph, so NO PROBE CAN IMPORT ANOTHER: any object or fixture the new probe depends on must be re-derived verbatim inside it, and the source probe is neither edited nor re-signed. (2) The gate `scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh` tests tracked-ness via `git ls-files --error-unmatch` AFTER its presence test, so a new probe must be `git add`-ed before the first gate run or it reports `FAIL (untracked: ...)` and its content is never measured at all. (3) A `FAIL (environment: ...)` label (missing-object-file error) is an I/O failure of the build tree, never probe rot: the response is to re-run once any concurrent `lake build` finishes, never to repair or retire a probe. Wiring is two edits: a two-column header table block and one `WIRED` array entry. The probe prototype may stay in its task directory as the research record; that coexistence is the established local pattern.
